description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique for each request. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest create-service-usage --service-id service-d6fc5f949a9246xxxxxx --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --user-information key=example-string --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
